capabilities: hide sidebars automatically when the window becomes too narrow
reopen sidebars when the window becomes wide again
set separate minimum width thresholds for the left and right sidebar
enable or disable management of each sidebar independently
choose whether only sidebars collapsed by the plugin are reopened
disambiguation: Not a manual sidebar toggle; it only hides and shows sidebars in response to window width changes.
extras: Fork of an unmaintained plugin with community-contributed fixes; the author accepts sponsorships via GitHub, Ko-fi and PayPal; installation can also be done manually by copying a release to the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of a currently unmaintained repo by Michael Hanson
problem: Obsidian leaves sidebars open and overlapping content when the window is resized to a narrow width, requiring manual collapsing and reopening.

summary: Window-width automation that automatically collapses the left and right sidebars when the window gets narrow and restores them when it widens again.
